badges.name: Lemon-Based Government
badges.desc: Buy Lemon Republic. — "You know who never pays taxes? The government. ...Wait, I have an idea."

badges.name: Cosmic Farmer
badges.desc: Harvest the cosmic cash vine. — "Who planted this? ...Actually, I don't care."

badges.name: Vigintillionaire
badges.desc: Reach a cash balance of $1 vigintillion. — "The zeroes are simply absurd now."

badges.name: Interstellar Lemons
badges.desc: Buy LemonX. — "Picture this:  Lemons. In. Space."

badges.name: Good Samaritan
badges.desc: Help the stranger in the sewer and obtain his reward. — "Now that I helped you, you can help me."

badges.name: Trigintillionaire
badges.desc: Reach a cash balance of $1 trigintillion. — "...Am I triggering something?"

badges.name: Quattuorquinquagintillionaire
badges.desc: Reach a cash balance of $1 quattuorquinquagintillion. — "Okay, come on. This can't be a real number."

badges.name: We Are So Back
badges.desc: Complete Dad's mission. — "Good job, my child."

badges.name: Ultimate Power
badges.desc: Fully unlock every power. — "POWER! Mwahahaha!"

badges.name: The Visitors
badges.desc: You were there for an Alien Invasion Event!

badges.name: Centillionaire
badges.desc: Reach a cash balance of $1 centillion. — "Another day, another dollar."

badges.name: Purity
badges.desc: Achieve the purest form of fruit. — "Can I eat this? ...Should I eat this?"

badges.name: Out of Breath
badges.desc: Buy the Oxygen Pump. — "Let’s sell air!?"

badges.name: Nothing Burger
badges.desc: Buy Fast Oxygen. — "Mmm, my favorite!"

badges.name: Robot Craze
badges.desc: Buy Oxygen Warehouse. — "This bubble is getting too big."

badges.name: Community Bonding
badges.desc: Buy Oxygen Center. — "WE yes, we are all on this planet together."

badges.name: A Lotta Oxygen
badges.desc: Buy Oxygen Gardens. — "Touch grass."

badges.name: Breezy Vacation
badges.desc: Buy Oxygen Resort. — "Y'know, I never really liked the hotel prices back home."

badges.name: Reach to the Sky
badges.desc: Buy Orbital Oxygen Port. — "They said the sky’s the limit! But uh- what if you’re in space?"

badges.name: Floating Greenhouse
badges.desc: Buy Oxygen Forge. — "What’s cooler than space? More space!"

badges.name: You Peaked
badges.desc: Reach the highest point of the world using the jetpack. — "Lift off!"

badges.name: Spaghettification
badges.desc: Discover what’s on the other side of the black hole. — "THIS LITTLE MANEUVER COST US 51 YEARS!"

badges.name: Clarity
badges.desc: Finally have a thought on if you’ve gone too far. — "I think I finally have enough oxygen to think about it all."

badges.name: Brave Explorer
badges.desc: Venture into the sand caves and return victorious. — "Where did these ruins even come from?"

10090256806.name: TTK Testing [CUSTOMIZATION]
10090256806.title: TTK Testing
10090256806.creator: Sable Digital
10090256806.description:
THE XP/IC ECONOMY IS SUBJECT TO WIPES!
WEEKLY UPDATES, AND EVEN DAILY UPDATES SOMETIMES. The game is constantly growing, so these are usually pretty serious updates rather than maintenance.

Winner of Innovation in Tech at the 2026 Innovation Awards!

Press P to go into Helmetcam!
Want better visibility through optics? Try "Transparent Optics" in Settings to simulate both eyes open!

PC, mobile, Xbox, PS5, we're focusing on maximum compatibility right out of the gate.

<<This game is intended for co-op PVE squad AI mechanics, storybased doorkicker scenarios/missions, and team-based PVP modes.>

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/ttk-our-very-early-tactical-fps/4664539

Controls
Fire: M1
Aim: M2
Crouch: C
Lean left / right: Q / E
Swap weapon: Number

LEAD DEVS: PoptartNoahh, CanyonJack
